overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs DCT Premier Edition 0.8 HP Cold/Heat System with WIFI App is a versatile solution for maintaining optimal water temperatures in plunges up to 135 gallons. Ideal for both indoor and outdoor use, this system offers a temperature range of 37°F-85°F, making it perfect for muscle relaxation and stress relief through therapeutic cold and heat therapy. With its Wi-Fi-enabled control, you can easily adjust settings from your mobile device, ensuring convenience and precision. The built-in self-priming water circulation pump and two-stage water filtration system enhance water quality, while the automated ozone sanitation system ensures a clean and refreshing experience. Suitable for installation in fitness rooms or home spas, this system is designed for easy setup with quick connect hoses and a splash-proof digital touch screen.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: With your DCT chiller you can easily and efficiently cool your water down to a low of 37°F without the daily hassle of obtaining and adding ice! With the mobile app, the chiller can be powered on and controlled anywhere there’s a Wi-Fi connection. Additionally, the built-in ozone, filter, and strainer, will complement and simplify your standard recommended maintenance routine to keep your cold plunge water crystal clear and clean. Upgrade your cold plunge with a DCT chiller today!
General Features for Website: Seamless Integration with Dynamic Cold Tubs: Designed to work effortlessly with Dynamic Cold Therapy tubs, this system ensures a perfect fit and optimal performance, enhancing the aesthetic and functional appeal of your wellness space.

Advanced Cold and Heat Functions: Experience the best of both worlds with the ability to cool down to a crisp 37 degrees Fahrenheit (3 degrees Celsius) and the added capability of heat function. This versatility allows for a wide range of therapeutic applications, from soothing warmth to invigorating cold.

Intuitive WiFi Connectivity: Harness the power of technology with a WiFi-enabled app on your phone, offering seamless control over your system. Adjust temperatures, set schedules, and monitor your system's performance from the comfort of your smartphone.
Robust Warranty for Peace of Mind: Enjoy the confidence that comes with a 1-year warranty, ensuring your investment is protected and your satisfaction is guaranteed.
